text:
Elyse (partnerships): Heads up — a couple HW partners reported customers being billed during the marketplace cutover window last night. looks like entitlements were created but activating ~10-20m late for some accounts. :warning:

Sofie (partner-success): Ugh. which partners? any big impacted accounts?

Elyse (partnerships): EdgeWave and Saturn SI. Partner-Success already triaging with two customers. They see usage in the ledger before entitlement active flag flipped.

Jon (billing): Do we know if this is a reporting lag (UI/agg) or actual invoiceable events? If the raw usage events came in with partner_id and timestamp, we might be able to credit.

Priya (integrations): I pulled a sample — raw events show ingestion at 2026-03-21T02:13:44Z but entitlement activation time on our side = 2026-03-21T02:34:01Z. For those accounts entitlement created earlier but activation job delayed.

Marco (sre): SRE saw a backlog on the entitlement-activator queue around 02:15-02:40UTC. Autoscaler didn't spin new workers because the metric threshold used the wrong queue name for that worker group. pushing a hotfix now. :wrench:

Jon (billing): Okay if activations were delayed the safe move is to mark those usage events as "pending entitlement" and not invoice until resolved. Can we map affected usage by activation window? We should avoid charging customers for unentitled consumption.

Priya (integrations): I can run a query to list events where usage_ts < activation_ts AND activation_ts < activation_ts + 1h. sample query: ```sql
SELECT event_id, account_id, usage_ts, activation_ts FROM market_usage WHERE usage_ts < activation_ts AND activation_ts >= '2026-03-21T00:00:00Z' AND activation_ts < '2026-03-22T00:00:00Z';
```

Sofie (partner-success): If we need to issue credits, we need account list + partner-contract reference. I have a spreadsheet template.

Elyse (partnerships): Proposed immediate actions: 1) SRE revert to backlog temporary mode / apply hotfix (Marco); 2) Integrations run the query & generate list (Priya); 3) Billing hold invoices for cutover window and prepare credits for matching usage (Jon & Sofie); 4) Partnerships notify partners with initial postmortem & ETA (Elyse).

Marco (sre): Hotfix deployed to activator autoscaler, queue drain rate back to normal. I kicked off a manual replay of activations for the last 3 hours; still running. Watching for backpressure on ledger.

Priya (integrations): Ran the query, exported 482 events across 34 accounts. attaching gist link: https://gist.github.com/redwood/mock-entitlement-lag-482 (internal). JSON sample of an affected event:
```json
{"event_id":"evt_0023a","account_id":"acct_91","usage_ts":"2026-03-21T02:13:44Z","activation_ts":"2026-03-21T02:34:01Z","partner":"edgewave"}
```

Jon (billing): Thanks. I'll flag those accounts for a manual billing hold for this billing cycle and create credit memos where necessary. Also please mark rows where usage type = free-trial vs paid so we can skip non-billable usage.

Sofie (partner-success): I'm drafting a partner note — short, apologetic, includes mitigation steps and a timeline for full RCA. Will share w/ Elyse for review.

Elyse (partnerships): Good. One ask for follow-up: can we add a short SLA guard in the marketplace cutover playbook — if activation lag > 5m, temporarily mute usage ingestion to ledger or auto-tag events as "cutover-lag" so billing can filter? low-risk toggle.

Marco (sre): We can add a tag in the ingestion pipeline that checks entitlement state before marking event invoiceable. low-effort patch, I can own it.

Priya (integrations): I'll add a boolean field entitlement_verified: false for retro events and update once activations replay completes. That will help billing automation.

Jon (billing): Perfect. After backfill completes let's run reconciliation: compare sum(billable_tokens) where entitlement_verified=true vs ledger. If mismatch > threshold we produce credits.

Elyse (partnerships): Great. I'll prepare partner comms and include a sample of the reconciliation plan. thanks everyone. :v: 

entitlement-bot: NOTE: entitlement-activator autoscale fix deployed at 2026-03-21T03:12:07Z. queue_depth: 0 after replay.
